summary: Trivial delegation thunk: reads the global ForwarderToSub5998A1 and forwards its value as the integer argument to BooleanToIntConversion, returning the conversion result directly. No branches, no local state.

operations.description: Load the global ForwarderToSub5998A1 from 0x00599897 as the integer argument passed to the callee.
Call BooleanToIntConversion with the loaded global value as its sole argument.
Return the result of BooleanToIntConversion unchanged.

unresolved: Semantic role of the global ForwarderToSub5998A1 (value interpreted as a boolean by the callee) is caller-dependent and unknown here.
